=== Transition-based beeping busy beavers ===

Write <math>\mathrm{BBB}_{\mathrm{tr}}(n,m)</math> for the variant in which a beep designates a state–symbol pair (an instruction slot). As above, <math>m=2</math> is implicit when omitted. The score is one plus the configuration index of the last visit to a slot that is visited at least once and only finitely often; the halting slot counts as a visit. The initial transition is unrestricted, including writes of the blank symbol.

The value 8 for <math>(2,2)</math> includes a blank-writing first move. Fixing <code>A0=1RB</code> instead gives an exact maximum of 7, also formally proved in <code>small/theories/Normalized22.v</code>.<ref name="Coq-small-transition" /> Deleting the initial move, exchanging A and B, and reflecting the tape gives the restricted champion <code>1RB1LA_0LA1RA</code>, shifting its last relevant visit from configuration index 7 to index 6. The displayed champions use a first move to the right; tape reflection preserves their scores.
